tagline: No account, no cash. Invite is the table.
description:
No account, no cash, no game server. Invite is the table — everyone who opens the link takes a seat, the host deals. Works offline. Your chip pile lives in this file, so sharing the GIF shares the stack.

Texas Hold'em at one felt. Two hole cards, then the flop, the turn, the river. Fold, check, call, or raise. Best five of seven takes the pot. Toy chips only — nothing is wagered and nothing is paid out. Card faces are generic ranks and suits, not a branded deck.

On your own, two bots sit across from you. With friends, press Invite in the bar; two seats and the host can deal.

An unofficial port of Vintage Poker by Patrick Obermeier. The original is a React site on Node, Express and socket.io, with accounts and a wallet. This copy is not.
